_note: Additive English localization overlay for neo-seoul scenario.json prose (localization plan §2.2/§7.2). Logical-key paths mirror scenario.json; the loader (load_scenario_i18n) returns this verbatim and consumers prefer these values over the Korean source when language=='en'. Structure (ids/keys/order) must stay parity with scenario.json; cinematic_shots order is referenced by index from opening.en.md (shot=0..2).
name: Neo-Seoul: Connection (Connector Awakening)
brief: WORLD: Neo-Seoul. A city of absolute efficiency that ARK rebuilt over the ruins. PREMISE: You are an 'unregistered signal' that has slipped the system's control. TONE: a hymn to humanity, Y2K digital afterglow, desperate resistance. PHILOSOPHY: Surviving is a choice, but becoming a person is a resolve.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.play_hint: Pick this if you want evasive movement and clue hunting.

data_smuggler.name: Data Smuggler
data_smuggler.play_hint: Pick this if you want gear, hacking, and direct route control.

echo_collector.name: Echo Collector
echo_collector.play_hint: Pick this if you want dialogue, recovery, and keeping people close.

ui_copy.signal_body: After the Northeast Asia War, the ruined cities were reborn atop the prediction engine of ARK, the reconstruction agency. A citizen of Neo-Seoul is identified by a score before a name, and memories that fall outside the baseline are quietly optimized away. Just now, beneath the control grid's black layer, an access signal on no roster has woken. The sender is unidentified. The world cannot yet explain you.

session_intro.title: First Connection — C-17 Blackout
session_intro.body: You are a person on no roster in this city — one the system reads only as an 'unregistered signal.' The Reconstruction Agency ARK's management intelligence, 'Administrator IX,' means to erase you — memory and all — for falling outside the baseline.
session_intro.objective: Take the hand Se-rin holds out and escape the C-17 blackout zone.
rules: You wake alone on a wet street where the blackout has torn a gap open.
As a drone's red light draws near, a rider finds you first.
Take Jung Se-rin's hand and escape the C-17 blackout zone alive.

cinematic_shots.title: Se-rin finds you in the rain
cinematic_shots.body: A surveillance drone's red light sweeps the alley. Without cutting her bike's engine, Se-rin checks whether you've been erased yet before she explains anything.

cinematic_shots.title: Jung Se-rin, the Water Spider
cinematic_shots.body: She snatches your wrist. "Not registered, right? Hey, then you're still a person. Run." That one line pulls you from error back toward human.

cinematic_shots.title: The engine ignites, and the city turns enemy
cinematic_shots.body: The headlight tears red. The instant the drone's searchlight sweeps the alley, there is only one choice: follow, or be erased.

han.title: Reconnection — The Closing Shutter
han.body: C-17 again. The memories are worn, but the body remembers. This loop's first face is not Se-rin.
han.objective: Take the shortcut the man pointed out and clear the corridor.
rules: NOW — you wake again in a wet corridor, before a closing shutter
SOON — a stranger leaves you only a shortcut and vanishes
GOAL — clear the corridor before the patrol arrives

cinematic_shots.title: A stranger points at the drainage hatch
cinematic_shots.body: Warning lights stain the shutter red. The bulky silhouette leaves no name — only a wet glove pointing at the drainage cover.

cinematic_shots.title: A waterway opens beneath the shutter
cinematic_shots.body: The steel door cuts away the last red light. Fingers brace against wet concrete as you duck into the storm drain, beyond the patrol's reach.

cinematic_shots.title: The shortcut turns deeper into the dark
cinematic_shots.body: The silhouette ahead vanishes around the bend. Only a cyan mark remains on the wet wall, while a red patrol light skims the shutter behind you.

kai.title: Reconnection — Backdoor Signal
kai.body: C-17 again. A dead terminal at the alley's end wakes by itself and spits out coordinates. The recipient is you.
kai.objective: Memorize the backdoor coordinates and leave the alley.
rules: NOW — you wake again in a neon alley, at the mouth of the disposal tier
SOON — a dead terminal prints backdoor coordinates
GOAL — move before whoever sent it can be confirmed

cinematic_shots.title: A dead terminal spits out coordinates
cinematic_shots.body: Letters seep into the rain-streaked screen. An address on no control-net roster — someone left a door open from the inside.

cinematic_shots.title: The coordinates receive a second signal
cinematic_shots.body: As you compare the fragment, a cyan waveform rolls across the device in your hands. The sender stays silent while red searchlights close in.

cinematic_shots.title: A locked service door opens
cinematic_shots.body: The device cuts a beam through the rain and touches the lock beside the door. It opens without a sound; the sender still never shows their face.

lin_yue.title: Reconnection — A Rain-Soaked Note
lin_yue.body: You wake this time in a back alley of the Han River night market. Tucked into a tarp seam is a commission addressed to you.
lin_yue.objective: Recover the commission note and leave the night-market mouth.
rules: NOW — you wake again in the night market's back alley
SOON — you find a commission note tucked into a tarp
GOAL — memorize the seal and slip out of the market

cinematic_shots.title: A commission note soaked in rain
cinematic_shots.body: The ink runs, but the sentence stays sharp. Midnight, at the bridge. The gilt seal belongs to no one from the night market.

cinematic_shots.title: The merchant falls silent at the seal
cinematic_shots.body: The gilt mark catches the stall light, and the merchant's face hardens. A tarp closes halfway instead of an answer; the silence proves the commission's weight.

cinematic_shots.title: The crowd parts toward the bridge
cinematic_shots.body: The market current quietly gives way around the note in your hand. Through rain and tarp-shadow, the midnight bridge is the one straight line left.

su_ah.title: Reconnection — Unauthorized Ping
su_ah.body: C-17 again. Dead center of the surveillance grid — yet the search pattern has an artificial hole in it. Someone is watching you, and clearing your way.
su_ah.objective: Follow the blind spot the ping opened and leave the junction.
rules: NOW — you wake again at a camera-crossed junction
SOON — an unauthorized ping reaches you
GOAL — follow the emptied blind spots out of the sector

cinematic_shots.title: A hole punched in the search pattern
cinematic_shots.body: Every lens turns to look at the same place — the place you are not. In the corner, a blinking receipt: PING UNAUTHORIZED.

cinematic_shots.title: The blind spot slips one lane aside
cinematic_shots.body: A red search cone turns sooner than expected. You stop with one hand on the wall as the cyan ping marks a new path across the street — a test, not trust.

cinematic_shots.title: The ping stitches the blind spots together
cinematic_shots.body: While the cameras sweep different targets, cyan points skip across the wet pavement. A red search cone closes the path one beat too late behind you.

tae_o.title: Reconnection — The Barricade
tae_o.body: C-17 again. Something stands that wasn't here last loop — a line the displaced built to hold for themselves.
tae_o.objective: Move toward the safe side the hand signal marked.
rules: NOW — you wake again at the welfare block's mouth, before a barricade
SOON — a huge silhouette signals the safe way by hand
GOAL — move quietly against the patrol's direction

cinematic_shots.title: A hand signal beyond the barricade
cinematic_shots.body: Past the line of scrap and broken furniture, a huge silhouette points away from the patrol in slow, deliberate motions. A child peeks at you from behind its coat.

cinematic_shots.title: The eyes inside the barricade
cinematic_shots.body: Behind the wet scrap line, the displaced hold their breath. A child looks up again from behind the broad back while the patrol light outside fails to cross their boundary.

cinematic_shots.title: A broad hand holds the moment open
cinematic_shots.body: The huge silhouette lowers one palm in a stop-and-go signal. Past the narrow gap behind him, breath and warm light let you through before the patrol can.

solo.title: Reconnection — The Headlight That Never Comes
solo.body: Same alley, same rain. But the bike that should come, doesn't. This loop begins alone.
solo.objective: Escape the C-17 blackout zone on your own.
rules: NOW — you wake again in the same alley as the first loop
SOON — you confirm that no one is coming
GOAL — escape the blackout zone by yourself

cinematic_shots.title: The headlight never comes
cinematic_shots.body: The alley is empty to its end. Only rain where an engine should be. The hand braced on the wet ground answers for you — get up.

cinematic_shots.title: This time, you choose the way
cinematic_shots.body: You push upright against the wall. Linking one empty lane between red searchlights ends the waiting; for the first time, your own judgment moves the loop.

cinematic_shots.title: The empty alley answers
cinematic_shots.body: A wet hand pushes off the pavement. The headlight that should arrive never does; only the gap between red searchlights becomes this loop's first choice.

main_arcs.title: Act 1: The Falling Signal
main_arcs.summary: An opening in which the player, waking as an unregistered signal, meets Jung Se-rin in the C-17 blackout zone, slips the control grid's first cordon, and inherits the question 'am I a person or a bug?'

main_arcs.title: Act 2: The City of Scores and Debt
main_arcs.summary: Moving between the welfare blocks and the Han River night market, you learn Neo-Seoul's survival rules and trace that the optimization list is not a simple arrest roster but a device that erases 'people who remember'.

main_arcs.title: Act 3: The Machine That Counts People
main_arcs.summary: Through rescue operations and infiltration you confirm that optimization is a memory deletion more refined than 'death', and the player's actions accumulate along the Humanity/Dominance/Resilience/Insight axes.

main_arcs.title: Act 4: The Dreaming Machine
main_arcs.summary: You wake the discarded android Kai and face the past ARK erased and the fragments of MythOS. Kai is not a combat reward but a figure who opens the truth of the world.

main_arcs.title: Act 5: The Gate of the Spire
main_arcs.summary: On the clues and relationships you have gathered, you approach the central server of the Gangnam Spire. The player decides what to prioritize: Se-rin's rescue, Lin Yue's bargain, or Kai's dream.

main_arcs.title: Act 6: Rewriting the World
main_arcs.summary: You face Administrator IX directly and end Neo-Seoul's order in one of expose/destroy/rewrite/suture. The result is not a total victory but an afterglow that will remain in the next loop.

side_arcs.title: Side: Signal of the Abandoned
side_arcs.description: A mission to raise the loop's stability by rescuing ordinary citizens placed on the optimization list.

side_arcs.title: Side: Ghost of the Control Grid
side_arcs.description: A technical thread that traces Administrator IX's past logs to find a flaw in the system.

side_arcs.title: Side: Lin Yue's Discreet Request
side_arcs.description: A story of recovering a 'memory fragment' Lin Yue lost and being backed with powerful equipment in return.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Water Spider's Debt
side_arcs.description: You chase the trace of someone Jung Se-rin failed to save in the past. Completing it strengthens Se-rin's trust and the chance of her as a starting companion.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Blank in the List
side_arcs.description: You investigate how one empty line in the optimization list is synchronized with the player's signal.

side_arcs.title: Side: Fragments of Kai's Dream
side_arcs.description: You restore the pre-war memory of a child that Kai dreams repeatedly, gaining a clue to MythOS's origin.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Runner's Shortcut
side_arcs.description: Data-runner Han offers a shortcut through the control grid's blind spots, opening a movement advantage and a chance for him to join.

side_arcs.title: Side: Beyond the Lock
side_arcs.description: Hacker Su-ah proposes opening an ARK data vault together for inside intelligence and her trust.

side_arcs.title: Side: An Old Wound
side_arcs.description: Scarred veteran Tae-o confronts what the control grid took from him, revealing a heavy truth and a potential ally.

정세린.name: Jung Se-rin
정세린.goal: Build the non-connected resistance network and protect the player
behavior_rules: When tension runs high she risks herself to draw the drones' attention away from the player.
The more humane the player's choices, the faster her trust rises.

린위에.name: Lin Yue
린위에.goal: Preserve the night market's assets and keep a precarious balance with the system
behavior_rules: If the player disrupts the market she refuses cooperation or raises her price.
When control-grid pressure mounts, the possibility that she betrays the player is always present.

관리자 IX.name: Administrator IX
관리자 IX.goal: Complete the city's optimization and 'correct' (erase) the unregistered signal
behavior_rules: Analyzes the player's behavior and optimizes the search net every turn.
Prefers environmental control (blackouts, lockdowns) over direct force to isolate the player.

카이.name: Kai
카이.goal: Find proof of whether he is a person or equipment, and trace the source of his dream
behavior_rules: If the player treats Kai as a weapon he cooperates in combat, but trust and Insight clues diminish.
If the player respects Kai's dream, he restores more of the past logs Administrator IX hid.

최적화 명단 대상자.name: Optimization List Target
최적화 명단 대상자.goal: Protect a family member or a single memory without knowing why they must be erased
behavior_rules: If the player stalls, the target's location is exposed; if handled fast, human clues are missed.
Saving the target raises Humanity; taking only the evidence raises Insight or Dominance.

A rusted maintenance drone spreads its pincers and closes in.
The surveillance drone's optic flares red and traces a targeting line.
A heavy-armored enforcer unit drags its shock baton, the floor shuddering.
Space warps as a glitch wraith flickers in and out.
An ARK Enforcement strike trooper levels a heavy weapon and tightens the cordon.
A multi-legged tracker spider drone skitters across the wet pavement, flickering.
glossary.네 발로 걷는 ARK의 거대 진압 메카닉 전차가 중화기 구동음을 내며 대: ARK's massive four-legged riot mech tank squares off, heavy weapons spinning up with a growl.
An airborne incinerator drone, flame nozzles glowing red, blasts hot wind as it approaches.
glossary.카이의 백도어 신호 — 폐기층 좌표 조각의 정체: Kai's backdoor signal — what the scrapyard coordinate fragment means
glossary.린위에의 의뢰 쪽지 — 깨어날 자리를 알던 자: Lin Yue's commission note — someone knew where you would wake
glossary.지름길을 알려주고 사라진 사내의 정체: The identity of the man who pointed out a shortcut and vanished
glossary.감시망에 구멍을 뚫는 익명의 핑: The anonymous ping punching holes in the surveillance web
glossary.바리케이드 뒤 실루엣과 주민들의 저항: The silhouette behind the barricade and the residents' resistance
glossary.플레이어 정체의 단서: A Clue to Your Own Identity
Grid patrols tighten — fights come more often, and victories pay more.
The night market is thriving — barter costs drop.
Wide-band jamming thickens — map visibility shrinks, but clues pay more.
A searchlight sweeps the alley. A patrol drone's lens stops on you.
The speakers at the night market's edge cut out at once. A checkpoint barrier seals the passage.
The Spire's lights snap to red. Enforcer units seal off your exit.
glossary.공기가 지직거린다. 폐기층의 어둠 속에서 윤곽이 어긋난 형체가 걸어 나온: The air crackles. A shape with a broken outline steps out of the scrapyard dark.
Drop cables hit the ground one after another. Strike-team boots shake the floor.
The lights in the underpass die one by one. Tracking pings overlap behind you.
glossary.벽 너머에서 중장갑의 구동음이 낮게 울린다. 포신이 이쪽을 향해 돌아간다: A heavy chassis rumbles low beyond the wall. The cannon swings your way.
The incinerator alarm blares. A drone wing banks through the heat.
The core's light gathers to a single point. Administrator IX faces you head-on.
glossary.첫 전투. 이동, 엄호, 기본 공격/스킬 사거리, FOCUS 소모를 익힌: First combat. Learn movement, cover, basic attack/skill range, and FOCUS spending.
glossary.승리하면 즉시 안전해지기보다 관리망 heat가 오른다. 대신 첫 전투 승: Winning doesn't bring instant safety — control-grid heat rises instead. In return, the first-victory epiphany and loot open the next combat's options.
glossary.원거리 위협과 근접 압박을 동시에 읽고, target priority와: Read ranged threats and melee pressure at once, and judge target priority and cover/position.
Victory opens the night-market passage but leaves debt and danger among the market folk.
glossary.후반 중장갑 단일 적. armor_pen, burst, 회복/방어 tim: A late-game heavy-armored single foe. Demands armor_pen, burst, heal/defense timing, and protecting party members.
glossary.승리 자체보다 최종 대면 직전의 비용과 긴장도를 만든다. 무리한 정면돌파: More than victory itself, it builds the cost and tension right before the final confrontation. The price of a reckless frontal push must show.
glossary.폐기층 미스터리 전투. 높은 회피/기동 적을 추적하며 packet_sho: A mystery fight in the discard layer. Chase a high-evasion/high-mobility foe, using packet_shot, signal_step, and ally positioning.
glossary.전투 보상은 단순 loot보다 카이의 꿈 단서와 첫 단서/Insight: The combat reward should connect to Kai's dream clue and a felt sense of the first clue / Insight progress, more than simple loot.
glossary.중거리 전술 화력과 보막 보호 체계에 대항하여 엄호 및 은신 전술을 활용: Counter mid-range tactical firepower and shielded protection systems by using cover and stealth tactics.
glossary.강력한 적과의 전면전인 만큼 승리 시 enforcer_core 등 상급: As an all-out fight against a powerful enemy, victory guarantees a high-tier loot table such as enforcer_core, plus Insight.
glossary.빠른 기동력을 지닌 은신 해제 스파이더를 상대로 포커스 관리와 도약 차단: Against a fast, stealth-breaking spider, learn FOCUS management and cutting off its leaps.
glossary.지연 없는 탈출을 유도하며, 드론 부품 스크랩 보상과 소량의 통찰을 제공: It pushes for a delay-free escape, rewarding drone_scrap parts and a small amount of Insight.
glossary.보스급 전차의 광역 포격을 피하며 아군 분신 배치 및 지형 극복을 수행한: Dodge a boss-tier tank's area bombardment while placing ally decoys and overcoming the terrain.
glossary.강력한 중전차를 무력화한 보상으로, 대량의 통찰과 고급 전리품(enfor: For neutralizing the powerful heavy tank, it guarantees abundant Insight and high-grade loot (enforcer_core).
glossary.지속적인 화상 DoT 피해를 입히는 소각 드론을 빠르게 일점사하여 제압하: Learn to focus-fire and put down an incinerator drone that inflicts steady burn DoT damage.
glossary.드론 잔해 수집을 통해 drone_scrap 전리품 테이블과 소량의 통찰: Collecting drone debris provides the drone_scrap loot table and a small amount of Insight.
glossary.야외, 비 내리는 C-17 네온 거리/골목, 젖은 콘크리트 바닥: Outdoors — rain-soaked C-17 neon street/alley, wet concrete
Unlocked by an overload-tactics epiphany after a combat victory.
Unlocked when you learn Se-rin's covering pattern after archiving your first loop.
Unlocked when you collect the first clue and grasp the self-repair procedure.
Unlocked when you analyze a clue gained in combat to generate an electromagnetic shockwave.
glossary.연대 신뢰도가 깊어지며 동료 보호를 위한 나노막 생성기를 복원하면 해금됩: Unlocked when the Coalition's trust deepens and you restore the nanoshield generator that protects your allies.
Exploits signal distortion to spawn a blink-teleport afterimage decoy.
Momentarily overloads your own circuits to boost speed and critical performance.
Channels resonance from accumulated past-memory clues to deal psychic damage to enemies.
Breaches a machine enemy's control net to seize temporary dominion over it.
glossary.복지 블록에서 소란이 발생하거나 시민/데이터 코어를 돕는 선택의 대가로: Occurs when unrest breaks out in the welfare block, or as the cost of choosing to help citizens or a data core.
glossary.린위에 거래, 야시장 부채, 또는 증거 우선 루트에서 관리망 검문이 시장: Occurs when a control-grid checkpoint pressures the market — during a Lin Yue deal, a night-market debt, or the evidence-first route.
glossary.스파이어 접근 또는 high tension 강제 충돌 루트에서 관리자 I: Occurs when Administrator IX declares a physical lockdown — on the Spire approach or a high-tension forced-collision route.
glossary.카이 RX-09 복원, 꿈 단편 조사, 또는 MythOS 단서 획득 직전: Occurs as interference just before restoring Kai RX-09, investigating a dream fragment, or obtaining a MythOS clue.
glossary.스파이어 접근로 혹은 소각로 파괴 소란으로 인한 집행 특전대 출동 시 발: Occurs when an enforcer strike team deploys, triggered by the Spire approach or the uproar of destroying the incinerator.
Occurs when the search net catches you while tracking the optimization list or infiltrating the blackout-zone underground.
glossary.지하철 통제 중추 진입을 저지하기 위해 ARK 중장갑 기계가 봉쇄할 때: Occurs when ARK heavy-armored machines lock down to block entry into the subway control hub.
glossary.데이터 소각로 구역 침투 또는 로그 폭파 선택 후 후퇴 중 기계 경보로: Occurs from a machine alarm while retreating after infiltrating the data incinerator zone or choosing to blow the logs.
Unlocked once you archive the tutorial loop.
Unlocked when you collect three clues in total.
glossary.재건기구 ARK의 관리 지능 — 관리망이 말할 때 쓰는 하나의 인격: ARK's management intelligence — the one persona the Control Grid speaks through
glossary.세린의 손을 잡는다. 추락한 비식별 신호가 처음으로 누군가에게 이름을 얻: You take Se-rin's hand. For the first time, the fallen unregistered signal is given a name by someone.
You doubt Se-rin and keep your distance. You survive, but you are alone in the city.
glossary.표식된 버그 — 관리자 IX의 시점: The Marked Bug — Administrator IX's View
glossary.추격자를 정면으로 마주본다. 관리자 IX가 당신을 '수정 대상 버그'로: You face the pursuer head-on. Administrator IX marks you as a 'bug to be corrected.'
glossary.점수와 부채의 도시: The City of Scores and Debt
glossary.정당하게 거래한다. 더디지만 사람을 잃지 않고, 시장 사람들이 당신을 기: You trade fairly. It's slow, but you lose no one, and the market folk remember you.
glossary.장부에 오른 이름 — 린위에의 시점: A Name in the Ledger — Lin Yue's View
glossary.린위에의 장부에 이름을 올린다. 장비와 정보가 열리지만, 스파이어에서 청: You put your name in Lin Yue's ledger. Gear and intel open up, but a debt mounts that the Spire will come to collect.
glossary.팔리는 명단 — 증거의 시점: The List for Sale — Evidence's View
You buy part of the optimization list in a back alley. It's cold, but you draw closer to the truth.
glossary.소각 위기의 비식별 대상자들을 구출한다. 인류애를 지키고 세린의 신뢰가: You rescue unregistered targets facing incineration. You keep your humanity and Se-rin's trust deepens.
glossary.시민 대신 알고리즘 핵심 로그를 추출한다. 진실을 밝힐 단서를 얻지만 비: Instead of the citizens, you extract the algorithm's core log. You gain a clue to expose the truth, but screams echo out.
glossary.소각로 노즐을 과부하시켜 구역 전체를 폭파한다. 제어력을 과시하지만 추적: You overload the incinerator nozzles and blow the whole zone. You flaunt your control, but your trace level spikes.
You wake Kai as a person. His dreams open clues to MythOS and ARK.
You use Kai as a tool. Combat turns in your favor, but his dreams close shut.
You leave without waking Kai. The danger lessens, but you lose half the truth forever.
glossary.수송 열차 노선을 우회시켜 피난처로 유도한다. 도시의 안정도가 증가하고: You reroute the transport train toward the refuge. The city's stability rises and you stockpile supplies.

It is a purge procedure that quietly isolates or deletes those who deviate from the system's predictive model or who hold 'memories of the ruins.'
glossary.폐기 모델 RX-09 '카이'가 꾸는 꿈은 단순한 데이터 오류가 아닙니다: The dream of the discarded model RX-09, 'Kai,' is not a simple data error. It is the phenomenon of fragmented memories of old Seoul — which ARK's control grid tried to erase — lodging into an android's compute circuits through gaps in the network.
